_comment: How a figure is written to its decimal places on every screen and in every file: from its exact value, a half going away from zero (Dart's toStringAsFixed, which the app uses). Go's %.1f takes a half to the even digit, so a jitter of exactly 3.25 ms read 3.2 ms on a PDF and 3.3 ms on the screen beside it (found 28 October 2026). The Go writer (pingdomain/shared Decimal) and the app's loss line are both tested against these.
